limitations: This is an early prospective price-v2 period only; no comparison with old cohorts or improvement claim.
Each family has its own valid-decision denominator. Different references/pairs do not establish a head-to-head winner.
Overlapping H1 forecasts, correlated pairs and one trading day are not independent trials.
Net results are per-decision spread-adjusted return bps, not account dollars or realized trades; no financing or guaranteed fills.
All source rows used by fresh evaluation are retained exactly as stored payload strings. Large model input blobs are not copied.
Per-ledger SQLite snapshots and later scorecard reads are independently timestamped, not globally atomic.
Not-yet-due target exclusions remain pending; no forecasts or outcomes were backfilled.
